blocks.text: Claire Liu overpowered Alexandra Eala in the Prudential Hong Kong Tennis Open final on Sunday, November 8, winning her first tour-level title in straight sets, 6-3, 6-0. The 26-year-old American didn’t drop a set throughout the week. With the win, she is on track to rise to No. 69 from No. 102 when the Women’s Tennis Association (WTA) rankings will be updated on Monday, November 9. Despite the loss, Eala will rise to No. 15, a career-high ranking.
